entities.name: Authentication procedure initiated by network
entities.description: Authentication procedure initiated by the network when a NAS signalling connection exists. The network sends AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message and starts timer T3460.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to initiate authentication procedure. Contains parameters necessary for authentication response calculation.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network in response to AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE when authentication fails.

entities.name: T3460
entities.description: Timer started by network when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST and stopped when receiving AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE.

entities.name: eKSI
entities.description: Enhanced Key Set Identifier included in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message. Must be different from eKSI in initial NAS message during EMM procedure.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection exists
entities.description: Precondition for network to initiate authentication procedure. Required for authentication initiation.

entities.name: Authentication failed
entities.description: Condition that triggers sending of AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

relations.description: Authentication procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
Authentication procedure includes receiving AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
Authentication procedure starts timer T3460 when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
Receiving AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE stops timer T3460
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains eKSI information element
Authentication procedure requires NAS signalling connection to exist
Authentication failure condition triggers sending of AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
